title: Small U-Net
description: An encoder–decoder with skip connections for 32×32 segmentation: two 16- and 32-channel down stages, a 64-channel bottleneck, and two up stages that concatenate the matching encoder tensor before convolving. The single output channel of the 1×1 head is inferred from the output contract.
reference: Ronneberger, Fischer & Brox, "U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation" (MICCAI 2015), scaled down to 16/32/64 channels with padded 3×3 convolutions and nearest-neighbour up-convolutions; the count was checked against the same architecture written as a plain torch.nn.Module (448 + 2320 + 4640 + 9248 + 18496 + 36928 + 18464 + 18464 + 9248 + 4624 + 4624 + 2320 + 17 = 129,841 over its 13 convolutions).
